# PicoWorker

> PicoWorker (picoworker.xyz) is a two-sided marketplace for simple online tasks. Earners complete available tasks and offers, while businesses create campaigns and review verified results. Registration is free.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-30. Use the linked public pages as the canonical sources for current PicoWorker information.

## What PicoWorker is
PicoWorker is a micro-task platform. Available work may include following accounts, watching clips, testing apps, answering surveys, research and other clearly described online tasks.

## How earners use it
- Create an account for free.
- Browse tasks and offers available for the current country and device.
- Read the requirements before starting and complete them using the same account and device.
- Submit any required proof and follow the task status from the account.
- Eligible rewards are credited after verification by PicoWorker or the offer provider.

## How businesses use it
- Create a campaign and describe the required result.
- Choose the task reward, quantity and eligible audience.
- Review submitted proof or use supported automatic verification.
- Approve genuine work and reject submissions that do not meet the published requirements.

## Key facts
- Free registration for earners.
- Separate experiences for earners and businesses.
- Country and device eligibility can affect task availability.
- A task or offer must be completed and verified before a reward is earned.

## Common questions
- What is PicoWorker? A marketplace for simple online tasks and verified rewards.
- How do I earn rewards? Choose an eligible task, follow every requirement and wait for verification.
- Is PicoWorker free? Registration and browsing available tasks are free.
- Are all tasks available everywhere? No. Availability depends on country, device and provider eligibility.
- Does opening an offer earn a reward? No. Every listed requirement must be completed and successfully tracked.
- What does pending mean? A completion was recorded but has not received its final verification result.

## Name
PicoWorker is also written as pico worker, pico work or picowork. It is not the same company as Picoworkers, which rebranded to SproutGigs. The official PicoWorker website is picoworker.xyz.
